recommendation_input.task: Choose an icon for application settings.

measurement.first_request_rule: Record the first request after each deployment separately. Do not include it only inside a warm average.
measurement.matched_conditions: Use the same client, region, inputs, sample counts, request order, and short time window for control and treatment.

required_evidence: complete control and treatment HTTP response parity
first request latency separated from warm samples
production web and MCP function versions before and after
allowed_external_mutations: apply the exact lightweight candidate RPC migration with the guarded runner
repair only migration history version 20260713150000 after SQL and postflight pass
deploy control commit ba7f7ea18 to mcp-search-v2-beta for search measurement
deploy treatment commit cacd283cb to mcp-search-v2-beta for search measurement
deploy control commit ba7f7ea18 to mcp-search-v2-beta for recommendation measurement
deploy treatment commit cacd283cb to mcp-search-v2-beta for recommendation measurement
delete mcp-search-v2-beta after measurement or immediately after a rollback trigger
prohibited_actions: repair of any older migration history entry
user invitation or public beta message

rollback.latency_failure: Delete the isolated beta endpoint, leave stable production functions unchanged, and retain the unused additive RPC for separate review.
rollback.sql_failure: Rely on the single-transaction rollback and do not repair migration history.
rollback.history_repair_failure: Do not rerun the SQL. Verify the function and retry only the exact history repair.
rollback.parity_or_security_failure: Stop before treatment measurement, delete the isolated endpoint, and record the failure.
